 Xbox console users will receive 50 games from October 26 to 31. 
 Evgen Kovalov 
 GAMES 
 October 26 2026 
 Views: 9497 
 From October 26th to 31st, the Xbox ecosystem and Xbox PC service will receive a major catalog expansion, including the release of 50 new games for Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC. Of particular interest to audiences is the addition of three titles directly to the subscription catalog. Xbox Game Pass on the day of their official debut. The week's releases kick off with the wordless, atmospheric horror quest Ayasa: Shadows of Silence and the co-op restaurant development simulator PAO PAO, followed by a series of projects spanning a wide range of genres, from classic platformers to complex construction and survival simulators.
 The central events among the premieres on Tuesday and Thursday will be the anticipated projects from the service's library Game Pass, as well as re-releases of acclaimed classics. On Tuesday, subscribers will gain access to the supernatural detective thriller The Séance of Blake Manor, where players investigate the disappearance of a man at a Victorian séance. On Thursday, the subscription catalog will include the psychological space horror Mouthwashing, about the survival of the crew of a crashed cargo ship, and the dynamic adventure parkour action game Terrible Lizards. On the same day, the console release of the wild hunting simulator Hunting Simulator 3 and the expanded re-release of the cult detective novel The Wolf Among Us Remastered will take place, offering updated graphics, modern sound design, and a special monochrome cinematic mode called Noir Mode.
 The final October releases also feature a slate of independent titles, including the psychological neo-Giallo horror Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy, the nostalgic 2D arcade action game Fallen City Brawl, the hardcore roguelike shooter with culinary elements Sulfur, and the return of the platformer Croc 2: Kingdom of the Gobbos. Later this week, players will be able to try the dark night shift simulator Corner Shop: NightShift, the Metroidvania Ex Master, Zombie, and classic arcade and puzzle game collections. This tight release schedule confirms the platform provider's strategy of regularly expanding its catalog with both big-budget new releases and niche indie titles to attract a wider audience.
